scenes.tts: Bend one hair on a mouse's back. How many kinds of touch neuron can answer? It depends on the hair.
scenes.visual: A single hair on mouse trunk skin bends under a probe. Title card: One hair, three classes.
scenes.caption: Bend one hair on a mouse's back. How many kinds of touch neuron can answer? It depends on the hair.
scenes.narration: Bend one hair on a mouse's back. How many kinds of touch neuron can answer? It depends on the hair.

scenes.tts: Mouse trunk skin has three main hair types. Long guard hairs, awl aw keen hairs, and short, bent zigzag hairs.
scenes.visual: Trunk skin with one guard hair among many zigzags and some awl/auchene hairs. On screen: guard : awl/auchene : zigzag, about 1 : 23 : 76.
scenes.caption: Mouse trunk skin has three main hair types: long guard hairs, awl/auchene hairs, and short, bent zigzag hairs.
scenes.narration: Mouse trunk skin has three main hair types: long guard hairs, awl/auchene hairs, and short, bent zigzag hairs.

scenes.tts: For decades, touch classes in hairy skin were defined by recording. The ending behind each was only inferred.
scenes.visual: A recording trace beside a follicle with question marks where the endings should be.
scenes.narration: For decades, touch classes in hairy skin were defined by recording. The ending behind each was only inferred.

scenes.tts: What changed was genetic access. A Cree driver mouse, crossed to a reporter, marks cells that expressed one chosen gene.
scenes.visual: One population of ganglion neurons lights up among grey neighbours. Label: Cre driver plus reporter.
scenes.caption: What changed was genetic access. A Cre driver mouse, crossed to a reporter, marks cells that expressed one chosen gene.
scenes.narration: What changed was genetic access. A Cre driver mouse, crossed to a reporter, marks cells that expressed one chosen gene.

scenes.tts: But a label is only a handle, until recording confirms what the labelled neurons do.
scenes.visual: A labelled cell with a handle icon; a recording electrode approaches it.
scenes.narration: But a label is only a handle, until recording confirms what the labelled neurons do.

scenes.tts: Li and colleagues, in twenty eleven, did that check.
scenes.visual: Label: Li and colleagues, 2011. An electrode records from a labelled cell body.
scenes.caption: Li and colleagues, in 2011, did that check.
scenes.narration: Li and colleagues, in 2011, did that check.

scenes.tts: Neurons labelled by Track B behaved as A delta L T M Rs. They answer the tiniest hair deflections.
scenes.visual: Green TrkB label. On screen: Aδ-LTMR, 5.8 m/s, rapidly adapting, threshold below 0.07 mN.
scenes.caption: Neurons labelled by TrkB behaved as Aδ-LTMRs. They answer the tiniest hair deflections.
scenes.narration: Neurons labelled by TrkB behaved as Aδ-LTMRs. They answer the tiniest hair deflections.

scenes.tts: Neurons with C L T M R properties stained for T H. Slow, with intermediate adaptation.
scenes.visual: Clay TH label. On screen: C-LTMR, 0.58 m/s, intermediate adaptation.
scenes.caption: Neurons with C-LTMR properties stained for TH. Slow, with intermediate adaptation.
scenes.narration: Neurons with C-LTMR properties stained for TH. Slow, with intermediate adaptation.

scenes.tts: A third label, for some early Ret expressing neurons, picked out A beta R A L T M Rs. Fast, and rapidly adapting.
scenes.visual: Blue label. On screen: Npy2r-GFP, a subset of early Ret neurons. Aβ RA-LTMR, mean 13.6 m/s, rapidly adapting.
scenes.caption: A third label, for some early Ret-expressing neurons, picked out Aβ RA-LTMRs. Fast, and rapidly adapting.
scenes.narration: A third label, for some early Ret-expressing neurons, picked out Aβ RA-LTMRs. Fast, and rapidly adapting.

scenes.tts: Then they imaged whole sheets of trunk skin, to see which follicles each label surrounded.
scenes.visual: A whole mount of trunk skin builds follicle by follicle, each label in its colour.
scenes.narration: Then they imaged whole sheets of trunk skin, to see which follicles each label surrounded.

scenes.tts: Now bend an awl aw keen hair and hold it. Which labelled classes answer?
scenes.visual: An awl/auchene follicle, hair bent and held. On screen: which classes answer?
scenes.caption: Now bend an awl/auchene hair and hold it. Which labelled classes answer?
scenes.narration: Now bend an awl/auchene hair and hold it. Which labelled classes answer?

scenes.visual: The question stays on screen; a small countdown ring runs.

scenes.tts: Three classes can. A beta R A, A delta, and C. Their lan see oh late endings fence the same follicle.
scenes.visual: Blue, green and clay lanceolate endings light up around one follicle.
scenes.caption: Three classes can: Aβ RA, Aδ and C. Their lanceolate endings fence the same follicle.
scenes.narration: Three classes can: Aβ RA, Aδ and C. Their lanceolate endings fence the same follicle.

scenes.tts: Each ending runs lengthwise along the follicle, like one picket in a fence.
scenes.visual: Close-up: endings run parallel to the hair shaft like pickets, Schwann cell processes between them.
scenes.narration: Each ending runs lengthwise along the follicle, like one picket in a fence.

scenes.tts: Most awl aw keen and zigzag follicles also have circumferential endings from field L T M Rs, which Li did not label. That makes four classes at an awl aw keen follicle, and three at a zigzag one.
scenes.visual: A circumferential ending wraps the follicle last. Label: field-LTMR (Bai and colleagues, 2015). Tallies: awl/auchene 3 lanceolate + field = 4 classes; zigzag 2 lanceolate + field = 3 classes.
scenes.caption: Most awl/auchene and zigzag follicles also have circumferential endings from field-LTMRs, which Li did not label. That makes four classes at an awl/auchene follicle, and three at a zigzag one.
scenes.narration: Most awl/auchene and zigzag follicles also have circumferential endings from field-LTMRs, which Li did not label. That makes four classes at an awl/auchene follicle, and three at a zigzag one.

scenes.tts: Guard hairs carry A beta R A endings, and a touch dome beside the hair. Zigzag hairs carry A delta and C.
scenes.visual: Guard follicle: blue endings and a tan touch dome, labelled SA1, found through its Merkel cells. Zigzag follicle: green and clay endings.
scenes.caption: Guard hairs carry Aβ RA endings, and a touch dome beside the hair. Zigzag hairs carry Aδ and C.
scenes.narration: Guard hairs carry Aβ RA endings, and a touch dome beside the hair. Zigzag hairs carry Aδ and C.

scenes.tts: These combinations repeat across the skin. One movement of an awl aw keen hair can be reported by three classes in parallel.
scenes.visual: The three follicle combinations tile across the skin.
scenes.caption: These combinations repeat across the skin. One movement of an awl/auchene hair can be reported by three classes in parallel.
scenes.narration: These combinations repeat across the skin. One movement of an awl/auchene hair can be reported by three classes in parallel.

scenes.tts: Assume their spikes start together and travel equal paths of two centimetres. Conduction alone gives these arrival times.
scenes.visual: An arrival race over a 2 cm track. Label: illustrative, conduction only, mean velocities. t = L / v. Finish times appear: Aβ RA 1.5 ms, Aδ 3.4 ms, C 34 ms.
scenes.caption: Assume their spikes start together and travel equal paths of 2 centimetres. Conduction alone gives these arrival times.
scenes.narration: Assume their spikes start together and travel equal paths of 2 centimetres. Conduction alone gives these arrival times.

scenes.tts: The A beta and A delta reports arrive about two milliseconds apart. The C report arrives about thirty milliseconds later.
scenes.visual: The C runner crosses the line long after the other two.
scenes.caption: The Aβ and Aδ reports arrive about 2 milliseconds apart. The C report arrives about 30 milliseconds later.
scenes.narration: The Aβ and Aδ reports arrive about 2 milliseconds apart. The C report arrives about 30 milliseconds later.

scenes.tts: During the hold, the two rapid classes fall quiet. The C unit keeps firing for part of it.
scenes.visual: Three rasters: Aβ RA and Aδ fire at the bend and stop; the C raster continues into the hold.
scenes.narration: During the hold, the two rapid classes fall quiet. The C unit keeps firing for part of it.

scenes.tts: On longer paths, every gap grows. What fires, and when its spikes arrive, both shape what the spinal cord receives.
scenes.visual: The track stretches longer and the gaps between finishers widen. On screen: what fires, and when it arrives.
scenes.narration: On longer paths, every gap grows. What fires, and when its spikes arrive, both shape what the spinal cord receives.

scenes.tts: One caution. A single neuron branches to many hairs. So endings at a hair are not a count of neurons.
scenes.visual: One axon branches to several follicles. Label: endings are not neurons.
scenes.narration: One caution. A single neuron branches to many hairs. So endings at a hair are not a count of neurons.

scenes.tts: One hair, three classes, three speeds. The skin splits even a single hair movement into parallel reports.
scenes.visual: The awl/auchene follicle with its three endings, each sending a signal up its own axon.
scenes.narration: One hair, three classes, three speeds. The skin splits even a single hair movement into parallel reports.
